method: Independent native PNG visual inspection against recorded design brief and visible references, plus read-only alpha, cell-boundary, frame-distinctness and native-byte verification. Approval is specific to the recorded SHA; earlier reviewed revisions are retained in supersededReviews.

notes: Native atlas inspected against the Aurelia finish reference and Brass-Queen brief. An adult-faced royal automaton has copper curled hair, a brass crown, full imperial plate, opaque purple robes and a compact gear sceptre. Its two-arm/two-leg silhouette stays coherent without extra limbs.

All six rows and 48 distinct visible poses are present: arrival, two progressively stronger steam/heat phases, readable sceptre windup and recovery, non-graphic kneeling mechanical defeat and a subtle idle loop. The full character and meaningful effects are contained in each mathematical cell.

Native atlas inspected against the Freyja finish reference and Cryo-Valkyr brief. Silver short hair, angular ice crown, closed white-grey armor, deep-blue aurora cape and compact ice sword establish a distinct mature monarch identity.

All six action rows and 48 distinct visible poses are present, including two progressively stronger compact aurora phases, a readable sword-charge telegraph, non-graphic kneeling defeat and breathing/cloth idle motion. Full characters and readable effects remain in their mathematical cells; no alpha>24 content touches a boundary.

Native atlas inspected against the Aurelia finish reference and Duchesse Valva brief. A mature commander with warm brown skin, auburn hair, broad brass shoulder armor, burgundy waistcoat, purple trousers and boots carries a compact piston hammer and valve gauntlet.

Six rows and 48 distinct poses preserve identity, scale and camera. Steam and overheating phases build progressively; the hammer telegraph has clear windup, strike and recovery, while defeat kneels without gore or disappearance. Full bodies, hammer heads and meaningful steam effects remain within their cells.

Native atlas inspected against the Zahra camera/material reference and Ignis-Rah brief. Long dark hair, geometric gold solar crown, ivory-and-lapis armor, terracotta cape and curved molten-silica blade create a coherent mature solar sovereign distinct from the reference's turquoise costume.

All six action rows and 48 distinct visible poses are present. Blue mirage accents lead into a stronger solar-disc phase, followed by a readable blade windup, non-graphic kneeling defeat and idle motion. Broad colored preview haze is evaluated by the recorded alpha measures; no alpha>24 body or effect touches any cell boundary.

Native atlas inspected against the Zahra camera/material reference and Miraj brief. Warm brown skin, dark swept hair, black obsidian armor, lapis-and-amber scarf panels and two compact curved glass blades establish the armored battle dancer identity.

Six coherent rows contain 48 distinct visible poses: arrival, two escalating compact blade/refraction phases, dual-blade telegraph, non-graphic kneeling defeat and idle. No meaningful alpha>24 content contacts a frame boundary. Low-alpha surrounding haze is documented by the measurements and native pixels are preserved without cleaning.

Revision 2 inspected anew against the original native atlas. Skadi retains her red braid, fur collar, full blue armored robe, prism crown and crystal staff, with all six action rows and 48 distinct visible poses.

The smaller native redraw restores clearance around the previously touching staff-charge effect in heavy_telegraph. Every meaningful silhouette and effect is now contained within its own mathematical cell, with no alpha>24 boundary contact. No manual pixel cleanup or resampling was performed.

Revision 4 inspected anew against the previous native attempts. Astrid retains the platinum braid, insulated blue coat, heavy armor, aurora emitters, ice hammer and all eight action rows with 64 distinct visible poses.

The continuous grey-white matte from revision3 is gone. The corrected row placement is retained, and idle feet no longer spill into the attack row. Every complete visible body, raised hammer and meaningful effect is contained in its mathematical cell, with no alpha>24 boundary contact. Native generation bytes remain unchanged; no manual cleanup, cropping or resampling was performed.

Revision 2 inspected anew against the earlier native atlas. The copper-haired clockmaker keeps her purple coat, brass claw, gear dial and all eight authored action rows with 64 distinct visible poses.

The smaller native redraw restores foot clearance in the intro row, and no alpha>24 content now touches any frame boundary. Attack, mechanical claw, clockwork ultimate, victory, kneeling defeat and departure remain recognizable; no manual cropping or resampling was used.

Native atlas inspected against the Zahra finish/camera reference and Daria brief. A mature olive-skinned lancer with short dark hair, white ceramic armor, terracotta coat, blue inlay and a compact glass glaive forms a distinct coherent identity.

All eight authored rows and 64 distinct visible poses are present: arrival, idle, glaive strike/recovery, molten-glass charge, stronger golden storm, weapon salute, non-graphic kneeling defeat and departure. Complete bodies and glaive heads remain visible. The bright preview haze is checked by the alpha metrics; no alpha>24 content touches a cell boundary.

Revision 2 inspected anew against the earlier native atlas. Katya's insulated cap, grey-blue coat, white plates and beacon remain coherent across all eight rows and 64 distinct visible poses, with the same tactical-facing camera and authored action progression.

The smaller native redraw contains the previously clipped raised-beacon victory pose and ultimate effects. No alpha>24 content now touches any cell boundary. The aura is compact, transparent gutters are restored and the character stays visible in defeat and departure.

Revision 2 inspected anew against the grey-matte native version. Vivienne's auburn hair and goggles, burgundy engineering coat, brass armor and musket remain recognizable and consistent across all eight action rows and 64 distinct poses.

The continuous grey-white background has been removed in the new native generation: 56% of pixels are alpha zero, and no alpha>24 content touches any cell border. The complete body and musket stay visible in every frame, including non-graphic defeat and departure; no manual alpha cleanup was performed.

Native atlas inspected against the Freyja style reference and Astrid brief. Platinum braid, heavy blue-grey cryogenic armor and compact ice hammer form a coherent adult heroine; all eight action rows and 64 visible character poses are present.

Reject for cross-cell clipping. Eight mathematical cells have alpha>24 content on their borders, including attack row 3 column 5 at alpha 242, row 3 column 6 at 219 and row 3 column 3 at 191. Raised hammer/attack poses and other effects need to be smaller inside their cells. This is visible object content, not merely alpha 1–3 background noise.

Native atlas inspected against the Freyja style reference and Katya brief. Dark insulated cap, closed grey-blue officer coat, white armor plates and cryogenic beacon give a consistent sentinel identity. Eight action rows show a full adult character throughout, including non-graphic defeat and departure.

Reject for cross-cell clipping at the ultimate/victory boundary. Row 5 columns 4 and 5 have edge alpha up to 229 and 145; row 6 columns 4 and 5 reach 230 and 168. The raised beacon and surrounding action must be contained within the mathematical cells before slicing.

Native atlas inspected visually against the Aurelia finish reference and Vivienne engineering brief. Auburn bun and goggles, closed burgundy coat, brass armor and voltaic musket are coherent; eight distinct action rows are present.

Reject for a continuous grey-white background matte. Alpha ranges from 62 to 251, with zero alpha-zero pixels and zero pixels at or below alpha 16. Every cell border remains materially opaque. A fresh alpha-zero native generation is required; no manual background cleaning was performed.

Native atlas inspected against the Aurelia finish reference and Clarisse brief. Copper curls, purple combat tailcoat, brass chest armor, mechanical claw and handheld gear dial create a coherent combat clockmaker. All eight action rows and 64 visible poses are present.

Reject for insufficient foot clearance in the intro row: columns 1, 3, 4 and 5 have 6, 4, 5 and 2 boundary pixels above alpha 24, with maximum alpha 79, 49, 54 and 25 respectively. The first poses extend to their lower cell edges and need a slightly smaller or better-centered native redraw before frame extraction.
Revision 2 inspected anew against the earlier native atlas. Astrid's platinum braid, armor, hammer and all 64 poses are retained, and the broad background haze is substantially removed.

The reduced sprites are still positioned too low in the idle row. All eight row-2 cells have bottom-edge content above alpha24, with maxima 173–216; all eight row-3 cells receive the corresponding upper-edge spill at alpha35–82. This remains visible foot clipping despite smaller sprite size. Raise the local baseline to approximately 70–75% of every mathematical cell and leave a clear strip below the feet.

Native atlas inspected against the Freyja finish reference and Skadi brief. Red braid, fur collar, opaque blue armored priestess robe, ice crown and prism staff stay coherent across all six rows and 48 visible poses. Two phase activations, a readable staff windup, non-graphic kneeling defeat and an idle row are present.

Reject for a small but real effect crossing at heavy_telegraph row 4 column 5: two boundary pixels exceed alpha 24, reaching alpha 36. The staff-charge effect needs more clearance above its cell; remaining cells have no alpha>24 boundary contact. This is much smaller than Astrid/Katya's clipping, but does not meet the strict empty-gutter requirement.
Revision 3 inspected anew against the earlier native atlases. The 64 poses and Astrid identity remain present, and the idle feet appear visually raised into a more regular row layout.

Reject because this generation reintroduced a continuous white-grey background and soft floor shadows. Alpha ranges from 73 to 254 with zero alpha-zero pixels, so every cell border remains materially opaque. Preserve the revised arrangement and regenerate true alpha transparency, as was successfully done for Vivienne; framing must be remeasured on the transparent result.
